summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated in-package payload
details: @ornikar/slate-react-fork@1.0.8 declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<zip>`), extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated string-array bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shuffled-array indexer, multi-thousand-entry mixed-type constant table, no readable logic). The package's declared purpose is a React rich-text editor fork, which requires no alternate JS runtime; the dropper shape exists solely to execute the opaque payload at install time. The package name and description mirror the legitimate `slate-react` library, but the declared repository is `git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git` — a personal repo unrelated to Ornikar or the upstream ianstormtaylor/slate project — while the `dist/` tree appears to be a genuine slate-react build used to lend the package legitimacy.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
